title: Check the task-sync memory reader's deadline between keys and before returning a committed memory snapshot
outcome: Check the task-sync memory reader's deadline between keys and before returning a committed memory snapshot
acceptance: The committed memory read (task_sync::git snapshot memories::read) checks the reader's existing operation deadline while decoding keys after the body batches and before returning a snapshot, so a read whose deadline expires during decoding is refused with the existing deadline refusal instead of returning a successful basis.
A test drives a reader whose deadline expires after the last body batch and shows the read is refused, while a read within its deadline still returns the snapshot.
